name: Call Cupid!
source:
You had a break up? :O
Don't worry! Your personal Cupid is already on her way to help you out! 

Come and join the cute world of Call Cupid, where you can talk about your ex (who doesn't like that?) and get good (or bad) advice from your personal Cupid! 

[from [url=https://tanime.itch.io/call-cupid]itch.io[/url]]
